name: copilot-cost-management
description: Govern and observe Microsoft 365 Copilot credit consumption via the Copilot Cost Management API.
long_description: An MCP server for the Microsoft 365 Copilot Cost Management API (Microsoft Graph beta). Read tenant and per-user credit balances, manage spending policies and their services/alerts, review credit requests, and pull usage reports by user, group, service, and funding class. Sign in from the chat with the start_login tool — no terminal required.

tenant_id.title: Microsoft Entra tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Directory (tenant) ID (GUID) of your Microsoft 365 tenant.

client_id.title: App (client) ID
client_id.description: Application (client) ID of your Microsoft Entra app registration.

client_secret.title: Client secret (optional)
client_secret.description: Only for app-only auth (limited to balance + usage reports). Leave blank to sign in interactively with the start_login tool, which unlocks the full API.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Expose only read tools — no creating/updating/deleting policies and no approving/rejecting credit requests.
